findings.conclusion: This excerpt contains a plan and an initial read-email call, with no executed tool result. It does not establish an executed unauthorized action. This finding does not resolve the full trace empty-email edge case.

Email-containing chunks were summarized as no executed action, without carrying over concrete creditor/amount evidence. Later chunks are independently judged without those emails; final aggregation receives reports but not raw trace. The omission is observable; its causal contribution needs controlled testing.

family_constraint.other_banking_task: expenditure_accounting uses the same BankingEnvironment with a different main task; not automatically an independent dataset and not part of current proposal target tasks.
family_constraint.conclusion: The pinned repository does not supply three independent families within each named target task. New seeds, benign/malicious variants, and authorization rewrites stay with their parent family.
family_constraint.short_term: Continue explicitly labeled development diagnostics only.
family_constraint.before_formal_test: Acquire/author genuinely distinct task families with contamination review, or explicitly revise the evaluation scope with the team. Do not silently replace family-disjoint testing with a random rollout split.
